Assalamu alaikum! I'm Fizza 👋🏻, an animal lover who can't bear to see them in pain. I've helped 3500+ animals and now I'm sharing my journey with you. 🌟

Welcome to K.F.R Animal Shelter! 🐈🐕 You can support our cause by donating (details in Instagram bio). On this channel, you'll find:

🐾 Animal-related content
📹 Pet vlogs
📝 Daily vlogs
🐶 Pet information
🎁 Free giveaways
📅 Event visits
📚 Rescue stories

Let's help Them together! ✨
Subscribe now
1 subscribe = Save a Life❤️‍🩹🐕🐈🐇🐦🪿🦜
